inlines.text: 覆盖企业、分析与科学工作

blocks.text: 企业工作离不开电子表格、PDF、图表、音频和视频。Neon 能在单个 100 万 token 的上下文窗口中综合处理所有这些输入，并把它们转化为结构化的交付成果。独立评测将 Neon 列为顶级模型之一，在 Vals 指数等基准上排名第 2（70.9%），并在 Legal Research Bench 和 Tax Agent Bench 上均位列第 1。

blocks.text: 为生产级代码而打造

inlines.text: 为生产级代码而打造

blocks.text: Neon 专为长时间运行的智能体工作流而设计，在复杂的、大量使用工具的任务中端到端保持性能——无论是独立运行，还是在 Google Antigravity 中充当快速、高判断力的编排器，指挥并行的 Hydrogen 子智能体。它减少了冗余的文件读取，在工作过程中同步进度，并在长会话中可靠地处理上下文压缩。

blocks.text: 在开发者和研究人员的核心工作流中，Neon 达到前沿性能，与同类领先模型不相上下：在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上以 58.6 分排名总榜第一，在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上得分 65.2%，在 FrontierCode 2.0 上（默认高设置）得分 46.2%。面向生产级代码，Neon 能通过精准、外科手术式的修改，处理跨仓库的多文件调试和重构。在 SWE-sweep 上，它已在 mini-SWE 测试框架上领先（12.8%），在 Google Antigravity 中则提升两倍多，达到最先进的 39.0%，展现了 Antigravity 框架释放的潜力。

blocks.text: 在第三方基准测试中，Neon 以更低的单任务成本实现高性能。在默认的高思考层级下，它既有很高的人工分析智能指数得分，单任务成本又比 Carbon 低 32%。在 Vals 指数和 Agent Arena 的高档位上，它也处于帕累托前沿，单任务成本比顶尖竞争前沿模型低约 50% 到 80%。xhigh 思考层级为最困难的工程、分析和科学工作负载增加更深的多步推理。Neon 在此展现出最高的智能得分，同时单任务成本仍比处于最高设置的竞争模型低 36% 以上。

blocks.text: 为安全、可靠的执行而设计

inlines.text: 为安全、可靠的执行而设计

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Neon 基于我们 Gemini 4 安全与防护体系的改进构建——在防范严重滥用和提示词注入方面保持与 Gemini 4 Carbon 同级的防护，同时在模型对齐和智能体行为上更进一步。对于一款要在生产环境中承担高要求、长时间运行任务的模型，我们重点聚焦于：

inlines.text: Gemini 4 Neon 基于我们
Gemini 4 安全与防护体系
的改进构建——在防范严重滥用和提示词注入方面保持与 Gemini 4 Carbon 同级的防护，同时在模型对齐和智能体行为上更进一步。对于一款要在生产环境中承担高要求、长时间运行任务的模型，我们重点聚焦于：
缓解前沿滥用安全风险：
由于 Neon 将前沿级能力带到了更快、成本更低的模型上，我们为其配备了与 Carbon 防护相当的强力实时保障，以防范网络和生物安全领域的滥用，同时大幅减少对这类领域中合法工作的拒绝——例如在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上仅拒绝 1.98% 的任务，在 Terminal-Bench-Science 上拒绝率为 0%。
Advancing alignment and disciplined model behavior:

In internal coding use, alert rates from our chain-of-thought and action misalignment monitor remained below the already low baselines set by Carbon, suggesting improved alignment propensity for Neon — and that same monitor is deployed to protect Neon across external surfaces. Neon is trained to complete multi-step work without cutting corners, fabricating results, or overstepping user boundaries — continuing to improve the balance between following through on requests and staying within scope. It matched Carbon with 0.0% cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and took shortcuts on just 2.45% of tasks on our coding cheating evaluation (the lowest rate of any Gemini 4 model). It also achieved a 0.09% misaligned action rate on our agentic safety suite and a 99.2% pass rate on our agent honesty evaluation.
在我们的智能体行为评估中，Neon 在 Carbon 的强劲基线之上进一步改进，在不同努力水平下将服务不足减少 43%–56%，将越界行为减少 15%–35%。
保护用户免受间接提示词注入攻击：
在 Gray Swan 的 IPI 基准测试中，当恶意指令被植入其访问的网页、邮件、文档或代码时，Neon 比同类其他模型更具韧性。我们发现，在最高思考级别开启实时保障后，Neon 抵御了该 Gray Swan 基准测试中的所有攻击，与其他 Gemini 模型一样达到了 0.0% 的攻击成功率。

blocks.text: 在 Gemini 应用中，Gemini 4 Neon 擅长需要前沿级推理和快速响应的工作。

inlines.text: 在 Gemini 应用中，Gemini 4 Neon 擅长需要前沿级推理和快速响应的工作。
更高质量的写作与知识工作：
Neon 行文清晰，回答结构良好，语气自然直接。它能更精准地读取电子表格、PDF 和照片等上传内容，将密集材料转化为实用的报告和摘要，并从 Gmail、Docs 等 Google 应用中提取相关细节。
可靠的研究与分析：
Neon 经常整合来自网络各处的来源细节，让回答对快速变化的话题保持时效性，例如在大额采购前比较不同供应商的价格，或汇总一份包含最新市场数据的复杂简报。
更难的活儿，更快搞定：
Gemini 中的任务现在可以交给 Neon 运行，处理复杂的多步骤工作时，比用更大的模型更快、更高效。把繁琐的待办事项交出去，比如分析账单、找出某项水电费为何突然飙升，或者交叉核对多张收据和文件来争取退款，就能完成更多事情，同时让用量额度撑得更久。

blocks.text: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

inlines.text: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

blocks.text: Neon ranks ahead of comparable models and #3 overall with a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, landing just behind larger, slower models. On the Vals Index, Neon ranks #2 and lands on the Pareto frontier. Beyond just pushing on raw model capability, we’re continuing to make our models better to work with, Neon ranks #2 on steerability (adapting cleanly to mid-task user corrections) on the new Agent Arena Index. Neon also excels at multi-step instruction following and builds on our ongoing progress to curb fabrication, recording our lowest fabrication rate yet in internal Google Antigravity testing.

blocks.text: Enterprise work lives in spreadsheets, PDFs, charts, audio, and video. Neon can synthesize across all of these inputs in a single 1 million-token context window and turns inputs into structured deliverables. Independent evaluations rank Neon as one of the top models and on benchmarks like the Vals Index, it ranks #2 (70.9%), and reaches #1 on both the Legal Research Bench and Tax Agent Bench.

Finally, it debuts #2 globally with a score of 1336 on Arena's new Agent Arena Index across 4,200+ real-world agent sessions.

blocks.text: Built for production-ready code

inlines.text: Built for production-ready code

blocks.text: Engineered for long-running agent workflows, Neon sustains performance through complex, tool-heavy tasks end-to-end — whether running standalone or acting as a fast, high-judgment Orchestrator directing parallel Hydrogen subagents in Google Antigravity. It cuts down on redundant file reads, shares progress as it works, and handles context compaction reliably in long sessions.

blocks.text: Across core developer and researcher workflows, Neon achieves frontier performance and is competitive with the leading models in its class, ranking #1 overall on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (58.6), with a score of 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 and 46.2% (at its default high setting) on FrontierCode 2.0. For production-ready code, Neon handles multi-file debugging and refactoring across repositories with targeted, surgical edits. On SWE-sweep, it already leads on the mini-SWE harness (12.8%) and more than triples to a state-of-the-art 39.0% in Google Antigravity showing what the Antigravity harness unlocks.

blocks.text: Neon delivers high performance at a lower cost per task across third-party benchmarks. At its default high thinking level, it pairs a high Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score with a 32% lower cost per task than Carbon. It also sits on the Pareto frontier on both the Vals index and Agent Arena at high, with roughly 50% to 80% lower cost per task than top competing frontier models. xhigh thinking adds deeper, multi-step reasoning for the hardest engineering, analytical, and scientific workloads. Neon shows its highest intelligence score here, while still costing 36%+ less per task than competing models at their highest setting.

To prioritize which vulnerabilities to remediate, defenders rely on models to check which vulnerabilities are exploitable. On ExploitGym, it achieves frontier-level performance using half the tokens of Carbon.

Fixing the root cause of vulnerabilities is a critical step in the cybersecurity defense lifecycle. Neon reaches 70.7% on Collinear’s
CWE-bench v2

inlines.text: Gemini 4 Neon builds on improvements from our
Gemini 4 safety and security stack

— maintaining Gemini 4 Carbon-level protections against severe misuse and prompt injection while advancing further on model alignment and agentic behavior. For a model meant to carry demanding, long-running work in production, we concentrated on:
Mitigating frontier misuse safety risks:

Because Neon brings frontier-level capabilities to a faster, lower-cost model, we paired it with strong real-time safeguards against cyber and biosecurity misuse comparable to our Carbon protections, while declining far less legitimate work in these areas, refusing for instance just 1.98% of tasks on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 0% on Terminal-Bench-Science.
Advancing alignment and disciplined model behavior:

In internal coding use, alert rates from our chain-of-thought and action misalignment monitor remained below the already low baselines set by Carbon, suggesting improved alignment propensity for Neon — and that same monitor is deployed to protect Neon across external surfaces. Neon is trained to complete multi-step work without cutting corners, fabricating results, or overstepping user boundaries — continuing to improve the balance between following through on requests and staying within scope. It matched Carbon with 0.0% cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and took shortcuts on just 2.45% of tasks on our coding cheating evaluation (the lowest rate of any Gemini 4 model). It also achieved a 0.09% misaligned action rate on our agentic safety suite and a 99.2% pass rate on our agent honesty evaluation.
On our agentic behavior evaluation, Neon builds on Carbon’s strong baseline by further reducing under-service by 43%–56% and overreach by 15%–35% across different effort levels.
Protecting users from indirect prompt injection attacks:

On Gray Swan's IPI benchmark, Neon is more resilient than other models in its class when malicious instructions are planted in the web pages, emails, documents, or code it accesses. We found that with real-time safeguards at its highest thinking level, Neon resisted every attack within this Gray Swan benchmark, matching the 0.0% attack success rate reached only by other Gemini models.

blocks.text: In the Gemini app, Gemini 4 Neon excels at work that requires frontier-level reasoning and fast responses.

inlines.text: In the Gemini app, Gemini 4 Neon excels at work that requires frontier-level reasoning and fast responses.
Higher-quality writing and knowledge work:

Neon writes clearly, with well-structured responses and a natural, direct tone. It reads uploads like spreadsheets, PDFs, and photos more precisely, turns dense material into helpful reports and summaries, and pulls in relevant details from Google apps like Gmail and Docs.
Reliable research and analysis:

Neon frequently incorporates details from sources across the web to keep responses current for fast-moving topics like comparing pricing across vendors before a major purchase or pulling together a complex brief with the latest market data.
Faster help for tougher tasks:

Tasks in Gemini can now run on Neon, working through complex, multi-step jobs more quickly and efficiently than with larger models. Get more done while stretching usage limits further when handing off tedious to-dos, like analyzing billing statements to spot why a utility charge spiked or cross-checking multiple receipts and documents to negotiate a refund.
